Hi Tom / Maria —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the steering committee scheduled:

- Main goal: replace multiple rule-based NLP pipelines with a single Redwood inference layer for secure, low-latency document ingestion and summarization across your lending product lines.
- Primary success metrics: 95th pct latency < 200ms for summary endpoint, 40% reduction in ops cost vs current setup, and measurable improvement in reviewer throughput.
- Constraints: data residency in US, SOC 2 compliance evidence required for security review, procurement requires standard SOW + pricing breakdown.

- Economic buyer: Tom Reynolds (VP Product) — will own budget and go/no-go.
- Exec sponsor: Maria Gonzalez (Head of Data) — asked to chair steering committee.
- Security/legal: Jill Patel (legal) — will own security questionnaire and contracts.
- Procurement/Purchasing: procurement@fintegrate.com (we should confirm contact).

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule 60-minute steering committee (exec sponsor + econ buyer + security/legal + procurement + 2x engineering leads) — goal: alignment on scope, decision criteria, procurement timeline.
2) Share a 1-pager + steering committee pack prior to meeting. Attached a draft pack and SOW for review.
3) Security pack: Vivek/Neha — can you prepare the SOC 2 summary and short answers to the questionnaire highlights?
4) Tom/Maria — confirm availability next week (Sept 28, 29) or the week after (Oct 5-6).

If this looks right, I can send a calendar invite with two slots and the attached pack.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
